objective: Add repository/WSL-side coordination for 2-3 simultaneous mutating AI build sessions using session leases, path conflict detection, separate-worktree expectations, stale-main checks and a serialized integration lock, without changing the browser bridge extension or bridge transport code.
acceptance_criteria: No file under control/browser_extension/ is modified.
No bridge transport file is modified.
Two mutating sessions in the same worktree are blocked fail-closed.
Overlapping planned paths are blocked even when sessions use different worktrees.
Non-overlapping sessions in distinct worktrees can coexist.
Only one session can own the integration lock at a time and stale locks expire.
A session detects when origin/main advanced after its source commit and overlapping main changes block integration.
Publishing is blocked until the branch has been revalidated against the current origin/main and is based on it.
Runtime coordination state remains untracked under .runtime/.
Coordinator compile and focused tests pass.
non_goals: No changes to the browser extension or browser bridge transport.
No changes to heartbeat or scheduler business behavior.
No live trading, wallet, paid API or credential actions.
No force push or history rewrite.
independent_verification: Focused pytest coverage plus an independent repository diff check proving browser-extension and bridge-transport paths are untouched.
rollback_plan: Revert the coordination governance commit(s); .runtime/build_coordination is ignored and may be deleted after all sessions are stopped.
cleanup_plan: Session leases and integration locks are runtime-only. Sessions release them explicitly; TTL expiry prevents indefinite stale ownership.
